title: AquaWatch — System Architecture
system: IoT-Based Water Quality Monitoring and Predictive Alert System for Seabass Aquaculture
architectureStyle: Event-driven, cloud-centric IoT (Firebase as message bus / single source of truth)
designPrinciple: All components communicate exclusively through Firebase. No component talks directly to another, so any client can be replaced or added without touching the rest of the system.

layers.name: Perception Layer (Sensing)
layers.description: Physical data acquisition at the fish tank.
components: ESP32 DevKit V1 (DOIT) — microcontroller with integrated Wi-Fi
Resistive water-level strip (GPIO 17 power / GPIO 34 signal)

layers.name: Network Layer (Transport)
layers.description: Connectivity between device, cloud, and clients.
components: FCM (Firebase Cloud Messaging) transport for pushes

layers.name: Cloud Layer (Backend)
layers.description: Data persistence, business rules, and serverless logic.
components: Firebase Realtime Database (asia-southeast1) — single source of truth
Cloud Function: onAlertCreated (asia-southeast1, Node.js 22) — alert fan-out to FCM
Security Rules — role-based write restrictions, self-scoped user access

layers.name: Application Layer (Clients)
components: Worker mobile app (Flutter, Android) — live monitoring, alerts, sensors, reports, trends, frequency control
Admin web dashboard (vanilla JS + Firebase modular SDK) — configuration, analytics, reports, export

layers.name: User Layer (Actors)
components: Farm Worker — operates via mobile app; takes corrective action on alerts
Administrator — operates via web dashboard; defines standards and oversees operations

dataflows.name: Live Telemetry
dataflows.path: sensors -> median filter -> conversion -> tank_status (update) + TANK_01/history (append)
dataflows.frequency: Every sampling interval (default 15 s, configurable 15 s - 24 h)

dataflows.name: Live Dashboard Updates
dataflows.path: tank_status.onValue -> StreamBuilder / listener -> KPI cards + status tags

dataflows.name: Alert Pipeline
dataflows.direction: ESP32 (or mobile app) -> Firebase -> Cloud Function -> Devices
dataflows.path: threshold breach (severity + 5-min cooldown) -> TANK_01/alerts push -> onAlertCreated trigger -> FCM multicast -> phone notification

dataflows.name: Configuration Sync
dataflows.path: thresholds form -> TANK_01/config/thresholds (admin-only by rules) -> 60 s ESP32 fetch + instant mobile stream
dataflows.payload: { ph_min, ph_max, temp_min, temp_max, tds_max, waterlevel_min, waterlevel_max, updated_at }

dataflows.name: Reading Frequency Control
dataflows.path: frequency picker -> TANK_01/config/interval_seconds -> 60 s ESP32 config refresh applies it

dataflows.name: Incident Reporting
dataflows.direction: Mobile -> Firebase Storage + RTDB -> Admin Web
dataflows.path: camera/gallery capture -> Storage upload (reports/{id}/image_n.jpg) -> TANK_01/reports push -> admin Receive tab (realtime)

dataflows.name: Sensor Lifecycle
dataflows.direction: Mobile -> Firebase -> Admin Web + Cloud Function
dataflows.path: install/remove actions -> TANK_01/sensors node (countdown, computed status echoed) -> transition alerts -> auto-logged reports
dataflows.payload: { sensorId, type, installedAt, lifespanDays, expiresAt, status, removedAt? }

dataflows.name: Predictive Analytics
dataflows.path: TANK_01/history -> linear regression on TDS trend -> days-until-water-change estimate + forecast chart
dataflows.payload: days estimate + slope (ppm/day) vs admin tds_max

dataflows.name: Data Export
dataflows.path: TANK_01/history read -> CSV generation -> browser download
dataflows.payload: timestamp, temp, ph, tds, waterLevel rows

device.location: Tank-side, inside PVC junction box (splash-resistant, drip loops, silica gel)
device.firmware: Arduino C++ (Firebase ESP Client, OneWire, DallasTemperature)

backend.platform: Google Firebase (Blaze plan, within free-tier usage)
backend.security: RTDB rules: users self-access only; config writes admin-gated; tank nodes authenticated access

webClient.platform: Static vanilla HTML/CSS/JS + Firebase modular SDK v10 (CDN), Chart.js
webClient.accessControl: Admins listed at admins/{uid} = true; non-admins signed out automatically

repositoryStructure.MobileApp: Flutter worker app + ESP32 firmware + Cloud Functions source

keyDecisions: Firebase as the sole integration point — no client-to-client communication, enabling independent evolution of each component
Monitoring + alerting scope (no actuators/relay): alerts direct human corrective action, closing the loop via worker incident reports
Simulated sensor values during pipeline development, replaced by real hardware as each sensor was verified (documented transition)
Flat snake_case threshold contract as the configuration standard, enforced across web writes and device/app reads
Serverless push fan-out via Cloud Function instead of client-side notification dispatch
